comparison.objective: Cinch a loaded flexible bin liner, remove it, and release it beside the bin without spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable drawstring closure and bag extraction; candidate instead uses rigid screen handling and orientation-dependent passage of many rigid bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Requires bounded bag opening, retained contents, clearance from the bin, released tabletop placement, gripper clearance, and 2 s stability; candidate requires >=98% media recovered while every washer remains in the screen.
comparison.reason: Both penalize spills and include release, but bag cinching/extraction and aperture-based material separation test different abilities. No material rubric detail is missing.
